commands.name: sign
commands.description: Triggers a set of tests in teamcity from a pr

options.name: --searchpattern
options.description: Search Pattern - if empty it will search for the most common binary files. If empty, *.exe, *.dll, *.msi, *.nupkg, *.tsep, *.msix, *.vsix, *.appxbundle, *.appx, *.cab

options.name: --trustedendpoint
options.description: Metadata Json file endpoint. For azure-key-vault backend this is used as the Azure Key Vault URL. Falls back to the AZURE_TRUSTED_ENDPOINT env var, then to https://neu.codesigning.azure.net

options.name: --accountname
options.description: Account Name for trusted-signing backend. Falls back to the AZURE_CODE_SIGNING_ACCOUNT_NAME env var

options.name: --profilename
options.description: Profile Name for trusted-signing backend, or certificate name for azure-key-vault backend. Falls back to the AZURE_CERTIFICATE_PROFILE_NAME env var

options.name: --signtoolexe
options.description: Sign Tool Exe - default uses the shipped signtool [default: signtool.exe]

options.name: --excludefilelist
options.description: file containing a list of files that are not to be signed, each line is a regx. Example: System.*.dll

options.name: --includefilelist
options.description: file containing a list of files that should be signed only from the ones found in folder

options.name: --backend
options.description: Signing backend: trusted-signing or azure-key-vault. If not provided it is derived from --trustedendpoint (URLs containing 'vault' use azure-key-vault, otherwise trusted-signing)

options.name: --maxconcurrency
options.description: Max number of files signed in parallel. For the azure-key-vault backend this is also passed to the sign CLI's own --max-concurrency for batch signing. Defaults to the number of logical CPUs [default: 0]

commands.name: reportsignstatus
commands.description: Triggers a set of tests in teamcity from a pr
